description: Repo hygiene for T1 item 10. local_only checks need the verification toolchain; the signoff.yml runner skips them under --check. -17 supersedes manifests/item10-inventory-16.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-16.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed README.md, verification/README.md and .github/workflows/signoff.yml as of main before issue #180 reworded verification/README.md's CI section (make all enforces the toolchain.json pins locally through check-tools, which probes Yosys again; make smoke-fft256 records tool-version drift for the four tools it runs and does not probe Yosys) and repointed that workflow's item-9 and item-10 steps at the -9 and -17 pairs, so the verification/README.md and .github/workflows/signoff.yml hygiene entries' content hashes moved; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -16 supersedes manifests/item10-inventory-15.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-15.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed README.md, verification/README.md and .github/workflows/signoff.yml as of main before issue #71 removed the hand-rolled Yosys leg of smoke-fft256 and reworded those READMEs' smoke rows and prerequisites, and repointed that workflow's item-9 and item-10 steps at the -8 and -16 pairs, so those hygiene entries' content hashes moved; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -15 in turn supersedes manifests/item10-inventory-14.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-14.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed verification/README.md and .github/workflows/signoff.yml as of main before issue #170 refreshed the README's gen-exact row to the eight-configuration, directed-drop and fft_cmul unit-check shape PR #168 added and documented its GEN_EXACT_ROWS entry point, and repointed that workflow's item-10 step at the -15 pair, so both hygiene entries' content hashes moved; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -14 supersedes manifests/item10-inventory-13.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-13.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed verification/README.md and .github/workflows/signoff.yml as of main before issue #159 documented the fv-reports target in verification/README.md and repointed that workflow's item-9 step at the item9 -7 pair and its item-10 step at the -14 pair, so both hygiene entries' content hashes moved; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -13 supersedes manifests/item10-inventory-12.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-12.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed .github/workflows/rtl-ci.yml and .github/workflows/signoff.yml as of main before PR #155 added a bare merge_group: trigger to each workflow's on: map, so both hygiene entries' content hashes moved; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -12 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-11.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-11.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed .github/workflows/signoff.yml as of issue #129's item9 -5 pair, before issue #151 repointed the workflow's item-9 step at the item9 -6 pair and its item-10 step at the -12 pair, so the workflow file's content hash moved again; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -11 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-10.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-10.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which recorded the .github/workflows/signoff.yml content hash as of issue #85's item-9 re-attest leg, before issue #129 repointed that step at the item9 -5 pair and so moved the workflow file's own hash; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -10 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-9.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-9.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed .github/workflows/signoff.yml before issue #85 added the item-9 re-attest leg to that workflow and repointed the item-10 step at that pair; the same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -9 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-8.json and its attestation manifests/item10-attestation-8.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed .github/workflows/rtl-ci.yml and verification/README.md before PR #130 wired the generator unit tests (rtl/gen/tests/test_gen.py) into CI as the gen-unit / gen-unit-negctl make targets: rtl-ci.yml gained the two CI steps and verification/README.md documents the new targets, so both hygiene entries' content hashes moved. The same hygiene entries and checks are carried unchanged. -8 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-7.json and manifests/item10-attestation-7.json, which hashed measurements/fft256-smoke.json before issue #110 performed the live end-to-end smoke append that issue #94 left outstanding: make smoke-fft256 ran the default-path writer end to end and appended exactly one record (61525 cells, area 1022030.207999 um2 at tt_025C_1v80) below the committed 2026-10-30 record, so that hygiene entry's content hash moved. The same hygiene entries are carried unchanged; the previous checks are carried unchanged. -7 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-6.json and manifests/item10-attestation-6.json, which hashed verification/README.md and .github/workflows/rtl-ci.yml before PR #95 single-sourced the negctl must-fail contract into verification/negctl.sh and issue #90 replaced the loose-tolerance generator smoke in rtl/gen/tests/test_gen.py with verification/test_gen_exact.py (bit-exact vs the fixed-point model at six configurations), wired into rtl-ci.yml as the gen-exact / gen-exact-negctl make targets; those two checks joined the inventory so the bit-exactness evidence is attested. -6 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-5.json and manifests/item10-attestation-5.json, which hashed verification/README.md before its negctl.sh single-sourcing (PR #95). -5 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-4.json and manifests/item10-attestation-4.json, which hashed the README.md and the .github/workflows/signoff.yml of issue #79 before the Reproduce-table pointer fix. -4 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-3.json and manifests/item10-attestation-3.json, which hashed the README.md before the status alignment of issue #62. -3 in turn superseded manifests/item10-inventory-2.json and manifests/item10-attestation-2.json, whose checks (lint, sim, negctl) and hygiene entry measurements/synth-placeholder.json cover the retired placeholder flow. measurements/synth-placeholder.json is retained as history; the live synthesis record is measurements/fft256-smoke.json.
